headline.text: L3 ML4 bars on hold for *over-mixed* dark filling — sensory detected less white chocolate, pallets isolated pending disposition.

summary: One quality hold at L3 ML4 for appearance and taste deviation. L3 ML1 belt tear after metal detector flagged as food-safety concern; maintenance notified. L1 S4 salt spill caught and contained, 4 boxes scrapped.

holds.title: ML4 dark-filling bars on hold for over-mixing
holds.summary: Bars came out darker on top due to over-mixing; sensory testing shows less white chocolate taste despite correct weight — pallets isolated for disposition.
holds.status: On hold pending disposition — nothing discarded yet, awaiting release decision from QA.

food_safety.title: S4 excessive salt spill on conveyor
food_safety.summary: Operator dropped salt jar onto conveyor belt, spilling large quantity; entire affected batch pulled from Tunnel 1 and 4 boxes scrapped — no product released.
food_safety.status: Resolved — line paused, all affected product removed and scrapped, no hold needed.

food_safety.title: ML3 flow-wrap vacuum missing two bolts
food_safety.summary: Two bolts missing from vacuum assembly on flow-wrap machine — potential loose-hardware risk if bolts fell into product zone.
food_safety.status: Open — no follow-up posted on whether bolts were recovered or product inspected.

food_safety.title: ML1 belt tear on C1 (post metal detector)
food_safety.summary: Good-size tear found on belt after metal detector; belt is in food-contact zone and could shed material into product stream — maintenance notified to check for spare.
food_safety.status: Open — maintenance checking for replacement belt; production impact and interim containment not yet posted.

quality.title: Warped jar lids from new supplier lot
quality.summary: New lids (105,000 received) are warped and don't run properly on capper; may be isolated to one box but supplier contacted.
quality.status: Investigation ongoing — testing other pallets, supplier notified by procurement.

quality.title: ML4 underweight caddies rejected
quality.summary: Approximately 53 caddies (10 bars each) rejected due to low caddie weight; appears some bars were underweight — operator confirmed current bars are in range.
quality.status: Resolved — underweight caddies diverted, current production within spec.

quality.title: ML4 marked molds bypassed rejection
quality.summary: A few bad molds that were flagged in the system did not auto-reject; production team caught them before master case.
quality.status: Resolved — operator intercepted before packaging, no bad product shipped.

quality.title: S3 tray printer knocked over
quality.summary: South tray printer fell, broke sensor connector; approximately a dozen trays need to be re-printed or reworked.
quality.status: Resolved — sensor replaced, trays flagged for rework.

sanitation.title: S3 macadamia and pistachio clusters on floor
sanitation.summary: Clusters found on jar-area floor during shift; team cleaned immediately.

sanitation.title: ML1 Imperial hopper seal out of place
sanitation.summary: Seal found displaced during leak inspection; hopper removed, washed, and seal replaced before reinstallation.
sanitation.status: Resolved — hopper re-washed and seal replaced, now back in service.

sanitation.title: Nuts on floor in surrounding area
sanitation.summary: Nuts found on floor in general production area; flagged for cleanup.
sanitation.status: Resolved — cleanup completed per posted photos.

opportunities.text: Consider requiring two-hand salt application or spill guards on S4 salter station — based on today's jar-drop salt spill that required batch scrap.
Consider adding mold auto-reject verification step to ML4 startup checklist — based on today's marked molds bypassing rejection.
Review belt inspection frequency on ML1 post-metal-detector zone — based on today's C1 belt tear discovered mid-shift.
